transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thor! I’ve been gone for three weeks negotiating with the Dark Elves on YOUR father’s orders, and I return to THIS?! My rune-map — the one I spent months crafting — is soaked through with mead! There are scorch marks on the ceiling! You said you would keep the hall in order while I was away! What in the Nine Realms happened here?

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text:
Ah, Loki, it is good to see you have returned unharmed from your dealings with the Dark Elves. I must apologize for the state of our quarters. The hall may have gotten a bit... out of hand in your absence. As for the rune-map, I regret that it was caught in the midst of our... merriment.

You see, Fandral brought a particularly potent batch of mead, and Volstagg decided to test his tolerance against the lightning bolts of Mjölnir. It was all in good fun until things got a bit... chaotic. I attempted to maintain order, but you know how things can escalate when the warriors get carried away.

Rest assured, I shall make amends for the damage done. Allow me to assist in restoring your rune-map, and I shall ensure that such revelries do not occur in your absence again. The fault lies with me, and I shall take responsibility for it.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text:
Thor, your fondness for excuses does little to alleviate the fact that my works keep getting marred by your so-called merriment. "A bit out of hand" is rather generous, wouldn't you agree, considering the evidence hanging right over our heads like a blackened reminder of your antics? 

Assistance is all well and good, but can you truly resurrect a rune-map drenched in such carelessness? Months of meticulous enchantments wiped out in a single night of folly! Your promise rings hollow if you fancy such chaos again in the future. How might you assure me of the sanctity of my work henceforth, Thor? My patience runs thinner than your sense.

Loki, son of mischief, I understand your frustration, and I take responsibility for the havoc wreaked upon your rune-map. Your craftsmanship and dedication are not lost on me, and I regret that my actions have led to its desecration.

I offer no excuse for the chaos that unfolded in your absence. It was indeed a night of revelry that spiraled out of control, fueled by the mead and the spirit of competition. My words may fall short in assuaging your anger, but know that I speak from a place of genuine remorse.

As for the assurance of the sanctity of your work in the future, I pledge to you now, under the watchful gaze of Odin, that I shall uphold the sanctity of your creations with the utmost reverence. I shall exercise restraint in my revelries and ensure that such careless destruction does not befall your endeavors again.

Let us work together to restore your rune-map, piece by piece, as a symbol of our bond and mutual respect. Your patience may be wearing thin, but trust in me to learn from this incident and safeguard your works in the times to come. May our shared quarters be a place of harmony and creativity once more, Loki.
